text.p: These are the major headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Peru rebels put off killings: Canadian ambassador among four released to mediate hostage standoff.
- Canadian diplomat known as cool: Anthony Vincent expert on terrorism.
- Lucien Bouchard losing voter support: Cuts hurt Parti Quebecois, new poll suggests.
- Doubt about funds threatens Morin inquiry: Ontario left repeated pleas unanswered, commissioner complains.
- Moths on leashes reveal secrets of flight: Researchers photograph small wings flapping to unravel mystery of how insects get airborne.
- Avenor Inc to acquire Repap: C$3.3-billion deal would create Canadian forest products giant.
- Clyde Petroleum rejects Gulf Canada's hostile takeover bid: CEO determined to get British firm's North Sea assets.
- Intrawest to buy Whistler, Copper resorts: Firm will upgrade ski operations.
- CT Financial to buy Meloche Monnex.
- Avenor seeks to be No. 1 with Repap bid: Analysts say benefit of C$3.3 billion deal to shareholders is long term, but shares fall on short-term fears.
